_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: A new conversation from a conversation in an ordinary directory chooses the right directory. {{DIR}} is a directory holding a git repository {{REPO}} and a worktree of it, {{WORKTREE}}, which has a subdirectory {{SUBDIR}}. Conversation {{ID}} runs in {{DIR}}. To "start a new conversation": wait for ".header" to be visible; if the button in ".header" whose accessible name is exactly "New Conversation" is visible, click it; otherwise click the button in ".header" named exactly "More options", then the button named exactly "New Conversation" in ".chat-overflow-popover". "The directory control" on this phone-sized screen is the button in ".chat-overflow-popover" whose accessible name starts with "Directory"; to reach it, click the button named exactly "More options" first unless ".chat-overflow-popover" is already visible. Call "saved" reports the first message the page sends: "none" before it, then "ok cwd=<the conversation's saved working directory> draft=<whether it is still a draft>". To "send P and expect cwd C": fill [data-testid="message-input"] with P; call "saved", which must return exactly "none"; click [data-testid="send-button"]; then call "saved" until it returns exactly "ok cwd=C draft=false". To "check and send in C": the directory control's text should contain C; press Escape; then send "echo: new conversation directory" and expect cwd C. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{ID}}. 2. Start a new conversation. 3. The URL should become exactly /new (an exact path check). 4. Check and send in {{DIR}}.
